Flow.description: v72: Automatic Renewal — StartDate = Contract EndDate + 1 (EndDate = start + renewal term - 1); 'Create a ramp schedule' + Duration available on Automatic Renewal (Yearly, segments = term / duration); user-requested ramps now actually enable ramp options (groupRampsEnabled). v73: renewal term fallback (RenewalTerm2 else ContractTerm) on the contract + asset updates; fault connectors on every record element -> Fault_Capture -> Flow_Fault_Screen showing $Flow.FaultMessage.
